title: Dashboard save-city thread
summary: Source-level thread connecting the proposed POST /places mapping to the place-requested publisher, Forecasts consumer and publisher, and both Dashboard consumer views; linked views do not establish execution order or delivery.

process.scope: Dashboard.savePlace and its proposed Places.Save mapping, linked to the place-requested publisher, Forecasts consumer/publisher, and Dashboard consumer views.
process.trigger: A caller enters the source-declared Dashboard.savePlace handler.
outcomes: The declared HTTP and Kafka relationships are retained as separate views; target resolution, network result and downstream delivery are not established here.
